Hyperfine B constants of excited even levels other than 7s 4P1/2 (J=1/2, no B), and A constants of 7s 4P3/2,5/2 and 6d levels: none in the sources opened.
Measured lifetimes of 6p3 2D°3/2 and 2D°5/2: none located (theory only).
Measured M1 / E2 transition rates of the 876 nm and 648 nm lines: not found in an openable source.
Precise optical frequencies, laser cooling or clock lines: none located for neutral Bi. 209Bi is the only (quasi-)stable isotope, so there are no stable-isotope shifts.
conflicts: 6p3 2P°3/2 lifetime: measured 2.7(2)e-4 s (Krogulec et al. 1981, time of flight, abstract) vs calculated 5.8e-3 s (MRCI 2023), 5.8e-3 s (Garstang 1964), 6.2e-3 s (HFR 1996) - a factor of about 20. The measured value is kept as the entry only because the file rules prefer experiment; treat it as doubtful (possible misprint in the abstract record or a non-radiative loss in the beam).
6p3 2P°1/2 lifetime: measured 11.3(1.0) ms (Krogulec 1981) vs calculated 19(1), 16, 15 ms.

209Bi ground-state B: -304.654(2) MHz (attributed to Hull & Brink 1970 by Schmidt et al. 2018) vs -305.067(2) MHz (attributed to the same paper by Skripnikov et al. 2021, arXiv:2106.04308) vs -305.07 ('Exp. 2021' in Liu et al.); new measurement -305.2(5.7) cannot decide. notes: NIST labels the even levels in J1K notation; the LS names used in the literature are given in brackets. The 1972 beam-foil lifetimes were read from the publisher's abstract page by an automated reader: verify before relying on them, and prefer Luo et al. 1995 once accessible. Hyperfine constants of the 6p3 2D and 2P levels are second-hand and printed without uncertainties.
